name: entd-wix
description: ENTD Draws — Wix app (site widget + dashboard page), built with the Wix CLI.

scripts.sync: cd .. && API_HOST=api.entd.tech WEB_HOST=entd.tech npx webpack build --mode production --output-path wix/.entd-build && cd wix && ./bin/wrap-lib.sh
scripts.sync:staging: cd .. && API_HOST=api.aientd.space WEB_HOST=aientd.space npx webpack build --mode production --output-path wix/.entd-build && cd wix && ./bin/wrap-lib.sh
